Welcome to The London Vet – your trusted source for expert pet care advice, real-life veterinary cases, and behind-the-scenes insights from a practicing vet in the heart of London. Whether you're a pet owner, animal lover, or aspiring vet, you’ll find valuable tips, honest answers, and compassionate care right here. Join me as we explore everything from common health issues to extraordinary animal stories—all with a touch of British charm.

New videos weekly. Subscribe and be part of our pet-loving community!
